brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Stack of full bases at 0,0 levels 0-2 with top covers (cover:0,0,2;full;top and cover:1,0,1;half-w;top) provides shelf surfaces; staged with book-stack prop on top shelf.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks fit and mesh clearance only; it does not verify material, strength, load ratings, or safety. Parts are 3D-printed plastic in user-chosen material. No 50 kg rating can be claimed or verified here - shape suggests shelving but load rating is unmet.

Added notch drawer frames: notch:0#0,1#notch1, notch:0#0,-1#notch4, notch:1#0,1#notch1, notch:1#0,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch) - provides drawer compartments on both sides at two levels; meets two-drawer requirement (exceeds with four frames).

finish.summary: Built a 3-storey hex shelf tower with side half-bases and top covers as shelves, staged with books, and installed four notch drawer frames covering the two-drawer request. Load rating to 50 kg cannot be met - configurator only checks fit, parts are 3D-printed plastic with no verified strength rating.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
